message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Chelsea Market**.  
It’s a bustling food hall and marketplace in the Meatpacking District that attracts roughly 1.5 million visitors each year—more than any other indoor market in the city. Its mix of gourmet food vendors, artisanal shops, and a lively atmosphere makes it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
